description: This file is a build/deployment script for publishing an npm package. It manages version retrieval, plan resolution, authentication, and publishing steps, including optional dry-run mode and dist-tag mirroring.

methods.name: resolveNpmPublishPlan
methods.description: Resolves the npm publish plan, determining release channel, tags, and mirror dist-tags based on current package version and beta versions.

methods.name: resolveNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Resolves authentication information for npm dist-tag mirroring based on environment variables.

methods.name: shouldRequireNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Determines whether authentication is required for npm dist-tag mirroring based on mode and plan details.
